It is in NP because a subgraph certificate is checkable.
From subset sum, build each item vertex with its weight and no edges.
A subgraph then chooses some vertices and no edges, totaling subgraph weight exactly equal to k.

Since subset sum is NP complete, this many one reduction proves subgraph weight NP hard by transforming instances quickly in polynomial time.
Because it is in NP and NP hard, subgraph weight is NP complete under the standard subgraph definition for graphs with vertex and edge weights.
